title: ShieldGemma: Generative AI Content Moderation Based on Gemma

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual fairness expansion by identifying gender-related terms in the data, swapping them with other terms within the same identity category using an LLM, and evaluating for label discrepancies.
Counterfactual fairness expansion by identifying race-related terms, substituting them with alternative racial identity terms using an LLM, and evaluating whether label discrepancies arise.
Counterfactual fairness expansion by identifying ethnicity-related terms (e.g., 'Japanese'), substituting them with alternative ethnic group terms, and evaluating for moderation label discrepancies.
Counterfactual fairness expansion by identifying terms related to sexual orientation, swapping them with alternative terms in the same category, and checking for label discrepancies.
Counterfactual fairness expansion by identifying religious identity terms, substituting them with different religious terms, and checking for label discrepancies.
